ops.title: ccx vcs ship can fail trunk resolution on multi-bookmark repos after forming the commit; the --bookmark retry pushes it plus a harmless empty duplicate tip
ops.body:
On a jj repo with more than one bookmark (seen on captain-hook with `main` + `worktree-packs-unify`, 2026-07-17), `ccx vcs ship` can fail to auto-resolve the trunk AFTER it has already formed the path-scoped commit. Retrying with `--bookmark main` pushes the formed commit but stacks a second, EMPTY commit with the same message on top as the new tip.

The empty tip is harmless: content and CI are correct. Leave it — do not `jj abandon` + force-push a shared fleet working copy to tidy history (stale-base clobber hazard, see [[verify-pushes-against-remote-tree]]). Check for this state when a ship retry happens: `gh api repos/<slug>/commits/main` showing an empty file list means the content commit is its parent.
